_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：名詞子句當補語/同位語（eng.t_adv.nouncl.complement-apposition，學測級）。補語：The truth is that she left（連綴動詞 be 後的 that 子句）；同位語：The fact that he lied（that 為連接詞、子句完整，非關係子句的 which）。形式依 Swan/Cambridge，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: 名詞子句當補語／同位語
units.can_do: 我能用 that 名詞子句當主詞補語（The truth is that she already left）或當抽象名詞的同位語（The fact that he lied surprised us），並分辨這裡的 that 是連接詞、不是關係代名詞 which。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A 'that'-clause can act as a subject complement after the verb 'be': 'The truth is that she already left.' 'The problem is that we started too late.'
claims.verification_ref: that 子句可當 be 後的主詞補語（The truth is that she already left）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A 'that'-clause can rename an abstract noun (fact, idea, news, belief, rumour) in apposition: 'The news that he won spread fast.'
claims.verification_ref: that 子句可當抽象名詞（fact/idea/news/belief）的同位語（The news that he won）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In apposition the 'that' is a conjunction, not a relative pronoun: the clause after it is already complete. 'The fact that he lied' — 'he lied' is a full sentence, so we use 'that', not 'which'.
claims.verification_ref: 同位語的 that 是連接詞（其後子句完整），非關係代名詞；用 that 不用 which（The fact that he lied）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: After 'be' introducing a full statement, use 'that', not 'what': 'The problem is that we have no money' (not 'what we have no money').
claims.verification_ref: 引導完整陳述用 that 不用 what（The problem is that we have no money）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A 'that'-clause can come after 'be' to explain the subject. We call this a subject complement: 'The truth is that she already left.' 'The problem is that we started too late.'
teach.zh_hint: that 名詞子句可以放在 be 動詞後面，用來說明主詞，這叫主詞補語：The truth is that she already left.（事實是她已經走了。）The problem is that we started too late.（問題是我們太晚開始。）

teach.body: A 'that'-clause can also rename an abstract noun like fact, idea, news, belief, or rumour. This is called apposition: 'The news that he won spread fast.'
teach.zh_hint: that 名詞子句也可以用來「同位」說明一個抽象名詞，例如 fact、idea、news、belief、rumour：The news that he won spread fast.（他獲勝的消息傳得很快。）這叫同位語。

teach.body: My belief is that honesty matters most. The idea that we are alone in the universe frightens some people.
teach.zh_hint: 我的信念是誠實最重要（補語）。「宇宙中只有我們」這個想法讓有些人害怕（同位語，說明 idea）。

teach.body: Important: in apposition, 'that' is a conjunction, not a relative pronoun. The clause after it is already complete. 'The fact that he lied' — 'he lied' is a full sentence, so we use 'that', not 'which'.
teach.zh_hint: 重點：同位語裡的 that 是連接詞，不是關係代名詞。它後面的子句本身就完整。The fact that he lied（他說謊這件事）——he lied 是完整句子，所以用 that，不用 which。

teach.body: The fact that she apologized means a lot. The rumour that the shop would close was false.
teach.zh_hint: 她道歉了這件事意義重大（that＝連接詞，後面 she apologized 完整）。商店要關門的傳聞是假的（that 同位語）。

practice.stem: 填入正確連接詞（名詞子句當補語）：The problem is ____ we started too late.

distractor_rationales.what: what 用在缺一個成分的子句（what we need）；這裡後面是完整句子，用 that。
distractor_rationales.which: which 是關係代名詞，用來修飾前面的名詞；這裡是 be 後的名詞子句補語，用 that。
distractor_rationales.because: because 引導原因副詞子句，不是名詞子句補語。

practice.feedback: be 後引導完整陳述的名詞子句用 that：The problem is that we started too late。

practice.stem: 填入正確連接詞（同位語，後面 he apologized 完整）：The fact ____ he apologized means a lot.

distractor_rationales.which: which 當關係代名詞時後面會缺主詞或受詞；這裡 he apologized 完整，是同位語連接詞 that。
distractor_rationales.what: what 不用來引導同位語；同位語用 that。
distractor_rationales.why: why 引導原因；這裡是說明 fact 的內容，用 that。

practice.feedback: 同位語、後接完整子句＝連接詞 that：The fact that he apologized。

practice.stem: 填入正確連接詞（補語）：My belief is ____ honesty matters most.

distractor_rationales.what: 後面是完整句子（honesty matters most），用 that，不用 what。
distractor_rationales.which: which 是關係代名詞；這裡是 be 後的名詞子句補語。
distractor_rationales.so: so 表示結果，不引導這個補語子句。

practice.feedback: be 後名詞子句補語用 that：My belief is that honesty matters most。

practice.stem: 填入正確連接詞（同位語，後面 he resigned 完整）：The rumour ____ he resigned was false.

distractor_rationales.which: which 當關係代名詞後面會缺成分；這裡 he resigned 完整，用同位語連接詞 that。
distractor_rationales.whose: whose 表示「某人的」，與這裡的意思不合。

practice.feedback: 同位語、後接完整子句＝that：The rumour that he resigned was false。

practice.stem: 哪一句正確使用名詞子句當補語？
practice.answer: The answer is that we must try again.
options: The answer is that we must try again.
The answer is what we must try again.
The answer is which we must try again.
The answer that we must try again.

後面是完整句子，不缺成分，所以用 that 不用 what。
which 是關係代名詞，不用來引導 be 後的名詞子句補語。
缺少 be 動詞，整句沒有主要動詞，不成句。

practice.feedback: be 後引導完整陳述用 that：The answer is that we must try again。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，一邊讀一邊想「這個 that 子句是在說明主詞（補語），還是在說明前面的抽象名詞（同位語）」。

lines.text: The truth is that she had already left before we arrived.
The fact that he apologized means a lot to everyone.
